verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'expanded our partner network in Germany... five revenue generating partners in the DACH region... working with several certified consultancies across the German speaking markets, including the four leading global auditing networks (Big4)... own channel led new ARR generation in 2025... new ARR from own channels constituted 71% of total new ARR... partners experienced delay in decision making from their customers, which dampened our partner sales in 2025'. Channel Split section confirms partner vs own channel contribution.

details.completeness_justification: All HIGH importance criteria (K1-K7) are fully represented in the candidate summary with appropriate core meaning coverage. K8 (MEDIUM) is missing entirely, but this does not affect the overall assessment since all critical HIGH items are present. The summary captures ARR growth, EBITDA performance, churn/NRR/ARPA metrics, customer base expansion and diversification, regional growth drivers, product milestones, capital raising and cash position, and 2026 ARR/EBITDA guidance – representing a complete picture of the material financial and strategic developments.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support the overall narrative of resilient financial performance in 2025. There are no self-contradictions: revenue growth, profitability metrics, customer retention, and strategic shifts are all presented consistently. The relationships between causes (e.g., revenue growth, cost control) and effects (e.g., improved operating profit, stabilized cash burn) are logically sound. The organization flows logically from performance highlights to specific metrics, strategic decisions, and future outlook. There is no unnecessary repetition that reduces clarity. While EBITDA shows a loss compared to the prior year, this is explicitly explained by higher capitalized development expenditures, avoiding any contradiction. The summary forms a coherent whole without material internal contradictions or logical gaps.
